_about: Everything Metis needs on a computer, in one list. The install doctor
(metis_verify.py) checks each entry in this order and, with --fix, repairs
the ones marked repair=auto. A requirement that is not in this list is not
checked anywhere: add new requirements HERE, with a check of the same id in
metis_verify.py. tests/unit/test_essentials.py holds the two in step.
severity    what a problem counts as: fail = Metis does not work,
warn = it works with something missing
repair      auto = the doctor fixes it; person = it says what to do
platforms   which systems it applies to (windows, linux, darwin)
needs       dashboard = only when the dashboard is installed

essentials.name: This version of the operating system is supported
essentials.why: Older Windows versions lack what setup and the scheduled tasks rely on.
essentials.how: update Windows (Settings → Windows Update)

essentials.name: Enough disk space
essentials.why: The database, the search model and backups need room to grow.
essentials.how: free some space on this drive

essentials.name: Metis can reach the internet
essentials.why: News, new papers, updates and the first download of the search model need it; everything else works offline.
essentials.how: connect to the internet, or ask IT to allow pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, github.com and huggingface.co

essentials.name: Metis's own Python is in place
essentials.why: Metis runs in its own Python, separate from any other on the computer.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again

essentials.name: The Metis tools are installed
essentials.why: This is the program your AI app starts.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again

essentials.name: The installed tools match this version of Metis
essentials.why: The AI app runs an installed copy; an old copy is missing newer tools.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again

essentials.name: Metis can fill Word and PowerPoint templates
essentials.why: Slides, posters and letters are made on your own (or your institute's) templates.
essentials.how: reinstall Metis's tools (the repair does this)

essentials.name: The search engine can load
essentials.why: Searching inside your documents needs it, and it needs Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime on Windows.
essentials.how: ask IT to install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

essentials.name: Search works offline
essentials.why: The search model is downloaded once; after that search needs no connection.
essentials.how: connect to the internet and run the check again

essentials.name: Metis is connected to Claude Desktop
essentials.why: Claude Desktop only sees Metis when its settings name it.
essentials.how: quit Claude Desktop completely and open it again

essentials.name: Metis is connected to Claude Code
essentials.why: Claude Code keeps its own list of connectors.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again, then type /mcp in Claude Code to see Metis

essentials.name: Metis is connected to VS Code
essentials.why: VS Code's AI chat can use Metis through its own connector list (mcp.json).
essentials.how: restart VS Code

essentials.name: Metis is connected to Cursor
essentials.why: Cursor can use Metis through its own connector list (~/.cursor/mcp.json).
essentials.how: restart Cursor

essentials.name: Metis is connected to an AI app
essentials.why: Metis answers through an AI app; without one there is nobody to talk to.
essentials.how: install Claude Desktop from https://claude.ai/download, then run the check again

essentials.name: Metis starts when your AI app asks
essentials.why: Started exactly as the app starts it, from the app's own settings, and in time — an app gives up on a slow connector.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again

essentials.name: The dashboard is running
essentials.why: It shows your work, and it runs the morning scans while it is open.
essentials.how: open the Metis shortcut on your desktop

essentials.name: The dashboard's pages open
essentials.why: A running dashboard can still fail on a page.
essentials.how: restart the computer; if it persists, send the dashboard log to whoever shared Metis with you

essentials.name: The morning news and paper scans ran recently
essentials.why: The morning briefing reports what these scans collected.
essentials.how: leave the dashboard running (it starts by itself at log-on)

essentials.name: The daily self-check is scheduled
essentials.why: This check runs by itself every day and repairs what it can.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again

essentials.name: Claude Desktop writes the morning briefing
essentials.why: Each weekday a Claude Desktop scheduled task writes your briefing; it needs Claude Desktop signed in once.
essentials.how: open Claude Desktop and sign in; Metis then adds the task by itself

essentials.name: The dashboard starts when you log on
essentials.why: Without it the morning scans only run after you open the dashboard yourself.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again

essentials.name: Your Metis database
essentials.why: Your memory: projects, tasks, notes, library and news.
essentials.how: restore it from a backup (ask for help)

essentials.name: Metis's specialists are present
essentials.why: The librarian, the methods coach and the others are described in the agents folder.
essentials.how: run the Metis setup program again

essentials.name: Metis knows who you are
essentials.why: Your name and interests decide what Metis ranks and watches for you.
essentials.how: say hello to Metis in Claude Desktop

essentials.name: Metis is up to date
essentials.why: Newer versions fix problems and add features.
essentials.how: say 'update Metis' in Claude Desktop
